page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 server belonging to the High Clock Speed instance family. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is allocated 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. Virtualization is managed via KVM.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage and features zero GPUs. Storage must be attached externally over the network. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline throughput of 20 Gbps, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Because it provides dedicated high-frequency cores alongside a balanced memory capacity, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is structured for workloads that demand steady single-core throughput alongside multi-threaded scaling. Applicable workloads include large-scale web application serving, continuous integration and build pipelines, batch compute processes, and intermediate data processing environments that rely on external block storage.
